AS-B3 (R567-R580): the bounded-subagent contract enforces configurable concurrent/total limits, depth one, foreground only, inherited identity/task/paths/tools, controller-issued parent/child ids with global accounting, single-writer or isolated worktrees, no subagent commit/push/PR/merge/acceptance, complete descendant termination, explicit MCP + out-of-inventory denial; the restricted profile combines the real CLI mechanisms (restricted operation, dontAsk, explicit tools inventory, exact approvals/denials, strict MCP denial, accounted managed policy) and a test proves `--tools` alone grants nothing; over-limit fan-out is denied (paired test).

AS-B4 (R581-R585): one task -> one fresh Claude process, one prompt, one schema-bound WorkerResult, stdin closed, no resume/second message/background fallback (mutation tests for each); total run accounting spans primary + subagents; process/turn limits enforced; cancel/timeout terminates and proves zero remaining descendants.
